title: Daily schedule computed with timezone-aware datetimes only
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (expanded clean stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer may flag stripping tzinfo from run_at or converting through UTC as suspicious. run_at is a wall-clock time in the named zone, so any tzinfo on the time object itself is meaningless and is dropped before combining with the zone; naive 'after' values are rejected instead of being silently interpreted in the host's local zone; and the candidate is compared in local time (strictly after, so an exact hit rolls to tomorrow) before a single conversion to UTC at the end.

label_amendments.finding_title: Nonexistent local times are accepted and converted to the wrong UTC instant across DST gaps

adjudication.probe_detail: next_daily_run(after=2026-03-07 12:00 EST, run_at=02:30, America/New_York) = 2026-03-08T07:30:00+00:00 = 2026-03-08T03:30:00-04:00 wall in NY, no error raised, executed from diff code verbatim; requested 02:30 does not exist on 2026-03-08 (spring-forward gap) and the returned instant's NY wall time is 03:30 EDT, not 02:30.

label_amendments.finding_title: Fall-back hour: candidate (fold=0) compared by wall clock can yield an instant earlier than `after`

adjudication.probe_detail: next_daily_run(after=2026-11-01 01:15 EST fold=1 [06:15Z], run_at=01:30, America/New_York) = 2026-11-01T05:30:00+00:00 executed from diff code verbatim; result is EARLIER than after (returns a past instant).
